checks.check: the Arabic form really is Arabic (no English field name is left)
the English form of the same claim is recognised as the same claim
import-validate returns the canonical claim and the recorded changes
an Arabic digit inside an identifier is refused
an unknown Arabic field name is refused
an ambiguous day/month date is refused

refusal_reasons.hijri: claim refused: /submission_date: a Hijri date (هـ); the calendar is not converted here, write the Gregorian date as YYYY-MM-DD
refusal_reasons.identifier: claim refused: /patient_id: an identifier contains a non-ASCII digit (U+0660); identifiers are matched exactly and are never converted, so write it with ASCII letters and digits as it is issued
refusal_reasons.field: claim refused: /حقل غير معروف: 'حقل غير معروف' is not a field name this system knows; use the English name or one of the Arabic names in the field glossary
refusal_reasons.ambiguous: claim refused: /submission_date: the order of day and month is ambiguous (03/04/2026 is 3 April in some countries and 4 March in others); write the date as YYYY-MM-DD
